description: Phase 09 Prompt 22 — research packet integration. Semantic (vector) retrieval context may enter answer generation ONLY through Research Packet generation: the hybrid broker's merged envelope (deterministic authoritative + advisory semantic) is routed through build_research_packet_from_envelope, producing a metadata-only ResearchPacket (advisory) — never a final answer. The route never calls the synthesis adapter; semantic results never assemble a final answer outside the Research Packet / Evaluation layers. Review tier, confidence class, source references, freshness, and source-coverage warnings are preserved; no raw content / query / excerpt is persisted or emitted.
